_comment: Subscription model. The affiliate programmes rejected the publisher, so
this is the second revenue engine: a free public tier for everyone, and
a paid tier for people who want to act on the data.
The paid tier is NOT a paywall around the calculator. The calculator
stays free for everyone - that is what makes the SEO work. What is
paid is the part that takes work to use:
- Trip alerts: get an email when a price changes for a destination
- Watchlists: save destinations and get notified about them
- The full data export: every price point, every carrier, every
currency, as CSV/JSON
- The pricing-error monitor: a feed of newly-found inversions
Enforcement is server-side. The static site is public; the paid
features are served by a Cloudflare Worker that checks a signed
entitlement cookie against Cloudflare KV or D1. Nothing is hidden by
obfuscating the client - the premium DATA simply is not served
without a valid entitlement.
Payment: use a Merchant of Record (Lemon Squeezy at 5% + 50c, or
Gumroad at 10% + 50c). They handle VAT and sales tax worldwide, which
matters when you are a solo seller. The provider's webhook grants the
entitlement; the Worker revokes it on cancellation.
_checkout_url_comment: The checkout URL is the ONE thing this model still needs. Create a
Pro product and a Team product in your Lemon Squeezy (or Gumroad)
dashboard, copy the checkout links here, and the Subscribe buttons
Until then the buttons point at this page, so a reader who clicks
'Subscribe' lands somewhere real rather than on a dead '#' link.

free.label: Free
features: Every trip length and price, in your currency

pro.label: Pro
features: Price alerts for the destinations you follow
Full price and coverage data export (CSV + JSON)
The pricing-error monitor, updated as it is found
Early access to each month's catalogue refresh

team.label: Team
features: API access to the price and coverage data

_comment: The free tier must stay generous. The site's value as a search and
referral asset depends on the calculator being completely free, and
a paywalled calculator ranks far worse.
The Worker serves the site and the premium API. It is NOT in front
of the static site for the free pages - those are served by GitHub
Pages. The Worker only fronts the premium endpoints and the
entitlement check, so the free experience stays fast and free.
worker.name: esim-subscription
